title: voc/v1 body
description: A VOC (voice of the customer) note — the md body shape (md/v1): `name` is the document id, `markdown` the author's text, `# <name>` by convention its first line. Rendered as-is to rendered/voc/<name>/VOC.md.

markdown.description: The whole document as the author wrote it, stored and rendered byte-for-byte.
